retrievalProfile.description: A nostalgic 1970s-style composition featuring a joyful figure riding a horse against a vast, soft-focus blue ocean with top-aligned outlined serif text.
triggerTerms: horse riding on a coastal cliff

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered vertical composition showing a woman in light, airy clothing riding a dark bay horse. The background is a textured, hazy blue sea meeting a grassy cliff edge. The top of the frame is occupied by a single line of wide, outlined serif typography that spans the width.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a monochromatic blue expanse
Warm skin and horse tones contrasting with cool blue background
Textual header framing the top of the photographic scene

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, medium-full shot of horse and rider.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The rider's face and the horse's head form the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top horizontal text down through the rider to the horse's legs and the cliff edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant blue negative space provided by the ocean behind the subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep brown and tan (horse and rider's skin)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a hazy, lifted-black value range characteristic of vintage film.
paletteRestrictions: Primary palette limited to blues, browns, and creams

letterConstructionRules: Thin outlines with transparent or low-opacity fills
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all display text to maintain 70s simplicity.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s soft-serif aesthetic and wide stance.
Offers the decorative swash-like feel common in this era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus, grainy 1970s film photograph of a woman with curly hair riding a dark brown horse on a grassy cliff overlooking a vast, hazy blue ocean. The lighting should be soft and natural.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place expanded, outlined serif text in all-caps across the top margin. Use a thin peach-colored stroke for the outline and a transparent fill.

verificationChecks: Is the text outlined rather than solid?
Is the ocean background hazy and low-contrast?
Does the image have a visible film grain texture?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the rider
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the horse and rider are the central vertical focus.
Verify the text is legible but airy across the top.
Check that the horizon line is soft and not overly sharp.
Confirm the color palette remains muted and nostalgic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject (Equestrian) + Environment (Coastal/Ocean) + Texture (70s Film Grain) + Typography (Outlined Expanded Serif Header).
